subject: MedCore evidence + BYOK: prioritize ephemeral log carveout for PII redaction
messages:
From: Rajesh Patel <rajesh@medcore.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: MedCore Compliance <compliance@medcore.com>
Date: Sat, 19 May 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence package + short retention carveout question

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the demo last week. The compliance team reviewed the flow and we have one narrow ask before legal signs: can Redwood provide an evidence path that excludes raw PII from the normal audit export while still giving us the session-level metadata we need for investigations?

Specifically: 
- For a 30-day short window we need: timestamps, request IDs, model / variant identifiers, and a pointer to associated telemetry — but not the full request payload for PII-sensitive routes.
- MedCore is evaluating a BYOK requirement for the dedicated deployment; if we adopt BYOK can the evidence package show an auditable KMS handshake without exposing key material?

Attached a short template of the evidence items we typically accept (evidence_request_template.xlsx). We want to understand whether this is a product-level exception/path (temporary retention carveout + redaction) or a professional services delivery.

Can you loop in ops and product so we can triage the ask? Our timeline is tight: legal wants to close by 2028-06-01.

— Rajesh
Compliance, MedCore
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajesh Patel <rajesh@medcore.com>, MedCore Compliance <compliance@medcore.com>
Date: Sat, 19 May 2028 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Evidence package + short retention carveout question

Thanks Rajesh — looping in ops/product/security. Quick summary for internal triage: 

MedCore asks for a 30-day short window evidence package that omits raw PII from exported audit logs but preserves session-level metadata and an auditable BYOK/KMS handshake artifact. Legal wants signoff by 2028-06-01.

Questions for triage (please respond with feas/risks and a suggested owner + ETA):
1) Product: Is there a current retention+redaction knob we can use for route-level redaction? If not, how invasive is a temporary carveout flag per customer?
2) Ops: Can we produce a BYOK handshake artifact (e.g., signed key-wrap event, KMS key id + rotation metadata) without exporting key material? What privacy/legal controls needed?
3) Security/Compliance: Does a 30-day redaction window plus session metadata meet auditability bar if we include signed timestamps and request IDs?

Initial thoughts: if this becomes an ops-only delivery it may be a professional services scope and require runbook changes. If Product can expose a per-tenant retention & redaction policy toggle in Console (temporary carveout) that surfaces in the evidence export, that’s preferable.

Ben / Jonas / Priya / Grace — please reply with short bullets. I’ll coordinate with Rajesh on the legal timeline and assemble the evidence pack.

Thanks,
Marissa
Director, Product — Security & Compliance (Redwood Inference)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajesh Patel <rajesh@medcore.com>
Date: Sun, 20 May 2028 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Evidence package + short retention carveout question

Marissa — technical notes and constraints from runtime/ops perspective: 

- Redaction approach: we can support route-level payload suppression via streaming filters (we already have a prototype that masks tokens for customer-specified routes). That prototype writes a redaction marker in-place and preserves request id, model, token counts, and timestamps. Work to make it first-class in Console ~3 sprints (we can scope a minimal flag to gate the feature per-tenant in ~4 weeks).

- Evidence artifacts for BYOK: we can produce a signed handshake record containing KMS key id, key policy version, wrap/unwrap event timestamps, and a short verification blob (HMAC of handshake metadata signed by our platform key). This does not expose raw key material. I attached a diagram for the handshake we propose (keystore_handshake_diagram.png).

- Gaps/risks: 
  * For investigatory use cases, removing payloads reduces forensic fidelity; we should require MedCore to keep a local copy of any PII critical to investigations (we should document that in the evidence pack).
  * If we implement a temporary carveout flag, ops needs a rollback path and audit trail for toggles (who flipped it, when, and for how long).

Suggested owner/ETA: 
- Product (Marissa / Priya): scope minimal Console toggle + evidence export entries — ETA 4 weeks for minimal toggle, 9 weeks for hardened UX.
- Ops (Ben): implement toggle-enforced redaction + runbook for temporary enablement — ETA 2 weeks for runbook + emergency enablement steps.
- Security (Grace): define evidence schema and HMAC signing policy for handshake records — ETA 1 week to draft.

I can put together a one-page technical evidence layout by EOD Monday.

— Jonas
Staff Engineer, Platform
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rajesh Patel <rajesh@medcore.com>, MedCore Compliance <compliance@medcore.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 May 2028 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Evidence package + short retention carveout question

Rajesh / team — quick update and proposed next steps to meet your June 1 deadline: 

Summary of what we can commit to (high level):
- 30-day temporary retention carveout that redacts route payloads but preserves session metadata (timestamps, request id, model id, token counts).
- BYOK handshake artifact: signed metadata record (no key material) that includes KMS key id, policy version, and signed timestamp chain.
- Evidence export will include a verification HMAC and a short runbook note explaining the forensic limits when payloads are redacted.

Action items (owners + dates):
1) Grace: Draft evidence schema + HMAC signing spec — due 2028-05-24. (attachment: byok-exception-proposal.pdf)
2) Ben: Ops runbook + emergency enablement steps for toggle — due 2028-05-26.
3) Jonas: Minimal Console flag implementation plan + technical evidence layout (one-pager) — due 2028-05-26.
4) Priya: Legal/PS cost estimate if toggle is not ready and we need a PS-delivered evidence pack — due 2028-05-25.
5) Marissa (me): Consolidate evidence pack + proposed language for MedCore legal — due 2028-05-28.

Rajesh — if that timeline works I’ll track progress and share a single evidence zip to the link below once items 1–3 are in. If MedCore prefers a PS engagement instead of waiting for the toggle we can provide a priced delivery option.

Link to working folder: https://redwood-drive.company/s/medcore-evidence-pack

Thanks everyone — I’ll follow up with a short status email Thursday.

Marissa
Director, Product — Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
